precondition.description: 3x3 table with R1C1:R2C2 merged

primary.description: Merged cell split into a 2x2 block, and the newly split top-left block is aligned middle-center

instruction: Split the merged cell containing 'Merged 2x2' into 2 rows and 2 columns, then set the newly split top-left 2x2 block to middle-center alignment.
